race.description: Tradezone Powering Your Next Win (Bm65) Hcp
race.comment: DECADAD (5) gets the nod after converting second-up on the turf here. His prior fifth here involved genuine interference and equipment issues, indicating more merit than the margin suggests. Strips fitter and keeps a claimer on to set him up well at the weights. Can win again. UNFAITHFUL (6) resumes for a new stable and looks one of the main dangers. Has been fitted with two trials and the form around her last campaign stacks right up. SISTINE EXPLORER (3) looks one of the main dangers after going down narrowly in a BM60 here. She benefits from weight relief, though she rises in grade and was held by ANGARA at Warwick previously. COOL FIZZ (4) has strong distance form and was back to her best last time at Taree. Have to include on best figures.
